style: chunky casual mobile cartoon, thick dark outline, flat bold shapes, high-contrast saturated colours, clean vector shading
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c); no prompt carries a photographic cue. Every mechanical sprite declares its orientation in words (rule C.8) and all of them except sprite_icon_back are explicitly horizontally symmetric, so a mirrored generation can never break the mechanic - the code never uses flipX. Backgrounds are cut away by the pipeline for every sprite (rule F.1b), so no prompt argues about backdrop colour. sprite_road_tile, sprite_verge and sprite_lane_stripe are stacked vertically in a scrolling ring, so their prompts describe their TOP and BOTTOM edges rather than their geometry (rule F.1d) and their .meta carries a 9-slice border. The four crate colours each carry a different seal shape, so the delivery order stays readable on a compressed screenshot and without colour vision. No prompt contains the app name and no sprite carries lettering of any kind (hard rule 1) - the splash mark is an abstract hexagonal badge.
